source_message.text: I have finalized the boards, although there may be some changes while you are working, and I also need one additional change to the power board. There is also one small board containing just 8 addressavle leds. Since this is more work than I expected, I am considering accepting this milestone and creating a new one for $50 covering these 2 boards and that one led board. Would that be okay?

source_message.text: For the LED PCB, I need to know the spacing between the diodes.

source_message.text: Perfect. Regarding the leds, I think a level shifter is necessary. Also, the LED board doc specifies C2890036 (SK6812 Mini-E, 3228 package), whereas you shared C5142047 (SK6812SMINI-ER, 2835 package). Which one exactly do you intend to use so that I can revise the documents?
